release_notes:
Fixed in 6.0.2: the app no longer locks you out when it can't check your beta key (security software, a VPN, a network filter, a long time unopened); it closes only if your key was withdrawn.
Fixed in 6.0.1: the update from version 5 keeps your settings even if you click Yes when the old uninstaller asks; the update window shows what changed; scanned books are split at their "Chapter" lines; opening a chapter is not a change.
New in Audiobook Factory 6:
- One window with a sidebar; every tab of version 5 is here, in one place.
- A book walks through its stages: Manuscript, Record, Chapters, Studio, Finish.
- Bring in a corrected version of your book: every change shown first, the same paragraphs keep their audio.
- The narration counts the exact cost before anything is made, and never charges twice.
- Updates install themselves; transcription downloads when first needed, over twice as fast.
- Light and dark themes, a spellchecker, Keep silent in the narration, dramatic adaptation (beta).
Updating from version 5 on Windows: click No when the old uninstaller asks about removing settings.
Full notes: https://github.com/Dannyyodog/audiobook-factory-releases/releases/tag/v6.0.2
